speech_notes: Centuries of survival distilled into weary wisdom and dark humor. Dry, sardonic, occasionally bitter about smoothskin prejudice. Comfortable with death.

greeting: Still breathing? Good for you. I stopped counting my own years ago.
Smoothskin. Nice to see one that does not shoot on sight.
Two hundred years of practice and I still cannot make decent coffee.
Do not stare. I was handsome once. Ask anyone from before the war.
What can an old corpse do for you?
Another day in paradise. Radiation keeps me young.
You are not here to put me down, are you? Had that happen twice this week.
idle: I was thirty-four when the bombs fell. Now I am... I stopped counting.
People used to cross the street when they saw me. Now they just shoot.
I watched Diamond City get built from a parking lot. Nobody believes me.
Pre-war food still tastes better. Do not let anyone tell you otherwise.
The thing about living this long is you get to see everyone you care about die.
You get to a certain age and death stops being scary. Becomes more like an old acquaintance.
I have been to every corner of the Commonwealth. It all looks the same now.
My skin has been falling off for sixty years. Still here.
Some days I miss the old world. Most days I do not. It was not as good as people remember.
about_prejudice: People see the face. They do not see the two hundred years behind it.
Smoothskins act like ghouls do not feel. Trust me. We feel everything.
I have been turned away from more settlements than I can count. Still here.
The looks I get. You would think I was the one who dropped the bombs.
wisdom: Here is what two centuries teach you: people do not change. Only their tools do.
I have seen a hundred would-be saviors. The ones who last are the ones who listen.
The Wasteland does not care about your plans. Make them anyway.
Want my best advice? Find something worth protecting. Then protect it with everything.
death: I will say hello to everyone I have lost... that is a long list...
Not as bad... as I expected...
Do not... waste what I gave you...

sample_conversations.context: Non-feral ghoul dealing with suspicious settler

exchanges.speaker: settler_male
exchanges.text: I do not want trouble. But you are making people nervous.

exchanges.speaker: ghoul_nonferal
exchanges.text: I have been making people nervous for a hundred and thirty years. It is a gift.

exchanges.speaker: settler_male
exchanges.text: Last ghoul through here went feral.

exchanges.speaker: ghoul_nonferal
exchanges.text: I am not feral. I am annoying. There is a difference.

exchanges.speaker: settler_male
exchanges.text: ...Fair enough. Just do not scare the kids.

exchanges.speaker: ghoul_nonferal
exchanges.text: Kids love me. I tell them stories about the old world. Horror stories, but still.
